relationships.subject: ATF4
relationships.evidence_quote: cancer cells under immune pressure secrete slit guidance ligand 2 (SLIT2) through an activating transcription factor 4 (ATF4)-dependent pathway

relationships.subject: SLIT2
relationships.evidence_quote: which activates tumor-innervating nociceptive neurons and aggravates cancer-induced pain

relationships.subject: TDLN-innervating nociceptive neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: This activation then stimulates tumor-draining lymph-node (TDLN)-innervating nociceptive neurons and increases calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) secretion

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Consequently, decreased CCL5 secretion from immune-suppressed TDLNs promotes M2-like polarization of tumor-associated macrophages

key_findings: Cancer ATF4-SLIT2 activates nociceptors and TDLN CGRP release, immune-suppressing lymph nodes
Targeting nociceptors or the ATF4-SLIT2-CGRP axis restores immunity and improves ICB
